entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Viridian elf warrior troubled by visions who learns the secrets of Mirrodin and fights the vedalken wizard Janus.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A goblin born under an ill omen who lives in a Leveler cavern and becomes Glissa's companion.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: An amnesiac golem found in the Mephidross, created to fight the mycosynth infection, who regains his memory at the Knowledge Pool.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The Mirari transformed into the Warden of Argentum, who renames the plane Mirrodin after himself and slowly mutates from golem to monster.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who created Argentum and, with Jeska, dropped the Mirari there.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Karn's apprentice.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: The artifact Karn and Jeska left on Argentum, which became its Warden.

entities.name: Argentum
entities.description: Karn's world, a sterile world of mathematical perfection later renamed Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metallic plane named by Memnarch after himself, setting of the novel.

entities.name: Kane
entities.description: Glissa's friend and love interest, a Tel-Jilad Chosen, killed by Janus.

entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: Glissa's younger sister, killed by Levelers.

entities.name: Chunth
entities.description: The troll who explains the Levelers and dies after being blasted by a rogue troll.

entities.name: Strang
entities.description: A troll Elder who assassinated Chunth and is killed by an aerophin.

entities.name: Raksha
entities.description: The leonin Kha of Taj-Nar who supports Glissa.

entities.name: Ushanti
entities.description: A leonin shaman who heals Glissa and had a vision of her involved in the end of the world.

entities.name: Rishan
entities.description: Ushanti's daughter, killed by exploding artifacts.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A vampire master of the Vault of Whispers who attacked the Leonin for serum.

entities.name: Yert
entities.description: A pitiful Moriok reaper controller who guides Glissa to Geth.

entities.name: Dwugget
entities.description: The Krark-Clan chief and Slobad's surrogate father.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: The Neurok village leader who allies with Glissa to infiltrate Lumengrid.

entities.name: Lord Pontifex
entities.description: A vedalken lord who caused Bruenna's father's death and tries to deliver Glissa to Memnarch.

entities.name: Lord Janus
entities.description: The head of the Synod and the cloaked vedalken who hunted Glissa and killed Kane; melted by Glissa.

entities.name: Synod
entities.description: The vedalken ruling body headed by Lord Janus.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: The blue-skinned people who created the aerophin and are made cruel conquerors by the serum.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: A people once partners of the vedalken, now little more than slaves.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: The lion-like people of Taj-Nar.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad trolls
entities.description: Trolls who guard the Tree of Tales and use a ceremony that erases memories.

entities.name: Krark-Clan
entities.description: The goblin clan that found Slobad and whose folklore speaks of a path to the world's center.

entities.name: Levelers
entities.description: Constructs that come every 100 cycles to kill the greatest warrior in the Tangle.

entities.name: Aerophin
entities.description: Flying constructs created by the vedalken.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Undead soldiers who besiege Taj-Nar, controlled by Moriok.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: The leonin city besieged by the Nim.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: The vedalken city that holds the Knowledge Pool.

entities.name: Knowledge Pool
entities.description: A pool in Lumengrid that restores Bosh's memory and guards the way to the blue lacuna.

entities.name: Vault of Whispers
entities.description: Geth's lair in the Mephidross.

entities.name: Tree of Tales
entities.description: The troll-defended tree where Chunth keeps his chambers.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A swampy region of Mirrodin where Glissa finds Bosh and Yert.

events.summary: Karn and Jeska drop the Mirari on Argentum, where it becomes the Warden, explores, and renames the plane Mirrodin.
events.quote: An idea pops into his head to rename his new vision of the plane after himself: Mirrodin.

events.summary: Glissa has a vision while hunting a vorrac with Kane and distrusts the trolls' memory-erasing ceremony.
events.quote: She believes her visions are repressed memories that are key to the elves' past

events.summary: Chunth tells Glissa that Levelers come every 100 cycles to kill the greatest warrior; she steals a sword and escapes.
events.quote: every 100 cycles, the Levelerslevelers come to kill the greatest warrior in the Tangle.

events.summary: Levelers kill Glissa's parents and sister; green flame erupts from Glissa and she is dragged away.
events.quote: she finds they have killed her parents and sister.

events.summary: Glissa meets the goblin Slobad in a cavern.
events.quote: introduces himself as the goblin Slobad

events.summary: At Taj-Nar Ushanti sees a vision of Glissa and Raksha sends the pair to find the cloaked figure.
events.quote: He cannot leave during the siege, but he sends the pair to find the cloaked figure.

events.summary: Glissa and Slobad reactivate a golem and capture Yert, who agrees to lead them to Geth.
events.quote: She convinces Yert to take her to Geth by promising to get him a new reaper.

events.summary: Glissa confronts Geth, severs his vampire's arm, and takes his serum.
events.quote: Glissa takes his serum but leaves Yert behind

events.summary: Aerophins attack Taj-Nar and Rishan is killed by exploding artifacts as Glissa crashes the aerophin.
events.quote: Rishan steps out of a doorway and is killed by the exploding artifacts.

events.summary: Chunth reveals the elves' racial memory and the vedalken, then is blasted dead by a rogue troll who tells Glissa the world is hollow.
events.quote: A dying Chunth tells Glissa that the world is hollow before passing on.

events.summary: The cloaked vedalken melts Kane's metal with a bolt, killing him; Glissa maims the wizard and destroys his aerophin.
events.quote: hits Kane with a magic bolt from his staff that melts every piece of metal on his body, killing him in agony.

events.summary: Bosh sacrifices himself to save his friends at the Krark-Clan hideout and is later partly reassembled by Slobad.
events.quote: Bosh himself is blown to pieces.

events.summary: Glissa and Slobad rescue the cultists and Bosh from the Great Forge, finding the red lacuna.
events.quote: They rescue the cultists and learn that Bosh is with the refuse to be thrown into the furnace.

events.summary: Bruenna allies with Glissa against the aerophin and explains how the serum made the vedalken cruel.
events.quote: With her village under threat, Bruenna has little choice but to ally with Glissa.

events.summary: Glissa drinks the serum to free Bosh from a quicksilver beast, nearly drowns, and has a flare of waking as a first-generation elf.
events.quote: Glissa is forced to ingest her vial of serum to give her the awareness she needs.

events.summary: Lord Pontifex traps Glissa and Bruenna, boasting he caused Bruenna's father's death.
events.quote: he reveals he was the cause of Bruenna's father's death

events.summary: Glissa defeats and melts Janus, who admits trying to murder the races' champions to supplant Memnarch; Pontifex then turns on her.
events.quote: Glisa melts Janus with his staff in vengeance for Kane.

events.summary: Slobad and Bosh rescue Glissa, and the group descends below the Knowledge Pool to the blue lacuna as Glissa has a flare of Memnarch's mutation.
events.quote: the slow mutation of Memnarch from golem to monster
